Question 5
?

Given that L{tcos⁡(ωt)}=s2−ω2(s2+ω2)2, find the Laplace transform L{e3t⋅tcos⁡(4t)}.

a
(s−3)2−16((s−3)2+16)2
b
(s+3)2−16((s+3)2+16)2
c
(s−3)2−16(s−3)2+16
d
s2−16((s−3)2+16)2
e
(s−3)2−4((s−3)2+16)2
Submit
